label: Fence
pitch: The %s pays well for things with no serial numbers
note: The merchant in front of the station cantina. Buys Oda's rock drops at twice their value and asks no questions. It buys anything else you carry too ('*' in 'buys') at 'any_rate' of its value, the gear trader's rate, so nothing bought in town sells here at a profit. 'resells': false = what it buys is not sold on (it pays more than it would ask). Bounties stay at the port's fence: the Remnant officers are out in the home planet's desert.
